title: Infisical GHA OIDC on existing secrets plane
objective: Land the WIP OIDC intent as a GitHub Actions workload-identity binding on the existing Infisical client and capability broker, without a new Claude bootstrap path, without Infisical/secrets-action, and without injecting raw secrets into the live Claude install or SessionStart surfaces.
success_criteria: No file named claude-code-bootstrap.yml exists under .github/workflows after the change
capability_broker.py oidc-auth/login and hydrate_infisical trusted-operator login share one helper in ops/secrets; Infisical/secrets-action is not added
infisical-cursor-governance.yaml plus infisical-protocol.md record the GHA OIDC identity; ops/secrets/INFISICAL_OIDC_SETUP.md is not introduced as a second SSOT
install.sh, bootstrap_agent_environment.sh, and setup_claude_code_plugins.sh still hydrate no raw secrets and still do not call Infisical OIDC
make pr-check PASS on the feature branch vs origin/main

New Infisical folder /claude-code or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY injection into any model-controlled surface

Create the Infisical machine identity via Infisical API (preferred) or Infisical UI. Write identity_id into infisical-cursor-governance.yaml. Set GitHub Actions variable INFISICAL_IDENTITY_ID via gh api, not github.com Settings UI.

Run locked pytest on ops/secrets/test_aws_secrets.py, make capability-contract-validate, make capability-broker-preflight, and make pr-check. Prove .github/workflows has no claude-code-bootstrap.yml and no Infisical/secrets-action pin.

stress_test.blast_radius: ops/secrets Infisical login, capability broker preflight, inventory docs, and comment-only Claude bootstrap scripts. Wrong implementation would inject raw API keys into model surfaces or add a second CI secrets client. GitHub Environment production is not created, so existing workflows keep current trust.

risks.risk: Operator creates GitHub Environment production and unprotected first-run auto-create
risks.mitigation: Out of scope. Do not create that Environment in this plan

unknowns.question: Does Infisical org infiscal-l9 already have a GitHub OIDC machine identity, or must one be created?
unknowns.decision_effect: Reuse an existing least-privilege CI identity if it matches the intended subject; do not create a duplicate.

unknowns.question: Does any live GHA job need Infisical secret values in the next milestone?

unknowns.decision_effect: This plan does not add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to the bootstrap leak list. That list is owned by the Claude env-contract campaign.
